0022600229.text: The Timberwolves (8-3, 4-1 at home) host the Mavericks (6-4) in Minnesota's 12th game of the season, with the Timberwolves sitting second in the Northwest, half a game back, on a four-game winning streak and a 7-3 record over their last ten. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 124-94 win in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
